_meta._note: S212g-b — CXRMate-2 PDF re-verification: Table 2 CheXpert Plus (n=62) + ReXgradient (n=10000) dataset results (initially only MIMIC-CXR was ingested). Cross-dataset generalization is a key paper contribution. CXRMate-2 + DB-existing baselines (MAIRA-2 [CheXpert only — not evaluated on ReXgradient], MedGemma 4B, MedVersa, MedGemma 1.5 4B). Same 9 RRG metrics. CXRMate-2 SOTA across both datasets (ReXgradient GREEN 58.1 / RadGraph-XL 41.7; CheXpert Plus GREEN 32.7 / RadGraph-XL 30.4). Baselines absent from DB (Libra, DeepMedix-R1) skipped.
